definitions.acceptance_criteria: Observable outcomes that can be converted into automated tests without interpretation.
definitions.gate: A required evidence check proving a contract rule or invariant.

level.P1: Important; blocks by default for this suite.

dependencies.reason: Registry floor parity for Phase-5 Airlock.

attribute_presence_assert.constitutional_invariant: attribute_key used for tenant context MUST be app.org_id (or equivalent canonical key).
attribute_presence_assert.description: Asserts a required attribute is present on all spans matching a filter.

error_envelope_correlation.description: Asserts returned ERR-1 error codes correlate with emitted metric tags.

sampling_decision.description: Asserts sampling decisions for traces/metrics based on route/job patterns.

telemetry_signal_emitted.description: Asserts a specific metric signal was emitted with required tags and value type.

trace_span_relationship.constitutional_invariant: span attributes used for tenant context MUST use org_id (e.g., app.org_id).
trace_span_relationship.description: Asserts parent/child span relationships within a trace to prove context propagation.

encoding_rule.note: CS-0@2.2.0 restricts gate assertion modes to manual|automated. Runtime verification assertions MUST use mode='automated' with the primitive as 'type'. CI MUST treat these types as requiring the Runtime Harness Adapter.

ash_action.notes: tenant_fixture MUST encode org_id, not any alternative tenant key.

http_route.notes: path_template MUST be deterministic and free of regex wildcards.

recommended_fields.name: negative_tests
recommended_fields.notes: Denial cases; mandatory for high-risk domains.

recommended_fields.name: property_tests
recommended_fields.notes: Generative invariants / fuzz cases where applicable.

recommended_fields.name: evidence
recommended_fields.notes: Pointers to automation, queries, logs, or proofs.

required_fields.name: description
required_fields.notes: What is being proven and why it matters.

assertion_object_shape.mode: manual|automated (runtime primitives encoded as automated types; see dynamic_verification_standard.encoding_rule)

references.note: CG-0 defines the CI enforcement checks that operationalize TG-0.
Error envelope/codes used by denial tests to assert correct failure semantics.

rules.rationale: Prevents contracts from promising runtime safety that the repository cannot execute, eliminating enforcement theater for dynamic gates.
rules.text: Harness Interlock. If any <DOCID>-GATE contains runtime verification assertions (telemetry_signal_emitted, trace_span_relationship, attribute_presence_assert, error_envelope_correlation, sampling_decision), the target repository MUST include a Runtime Harness Adapter at 'test/support/v42_harness.ex'. CI MUST fail if such assertions exist and the harness entry point is missing.

rules.rationale: Prevents 'documentation-only' contracts that cannot be enforced in CI.
rules.text: All contracts MUST ship a companion <DOCID>-GATE test-gates artifact with machine-actionable acceptance criteria.

rules.rationale: Prevents silent drift where gates point at an older contract version. Without this, you can 'pass CI' while enforcing the wrong contract.
rules.text: Each <DOCID>-GATE artifact MUST set contract_ref.doc_id == <DOCID> and contract_ref.version == contract.version. CI MUST fail on any mismatch.

rules.rationale: Deterministic CI validation and reproducible hashing/pinning.
rules.text: Contract bundles MUST be JSON-only and MUST contain exactly: <DOCID>_Contract_vX.Y.Z.json, <DOCID>_Test_Gates_vX.Y.Z.json, bundle.manifest.json (no extras).

rules.rationale: Stable IDs are required for automated tracking, waivers, and audit history.
rules.text: Gate IDs MUST be stable, unique, and MUST NOT include placeholder tokens. Recommended format: <DOCID>-P0-001 / <DOCID>-P1-002.

rules.rationale: Most real incidents are denial-path failures, not happy-path failures.
rules.text: Contracts in high-risk domains MUST include explicit negative_tests covering cross-tenant access, unauthorized access, stale-version writes, and replay/idempotency abuse as applicable.

summary: Defines the enterprise gate system (P0/P1/P2) and the assertion-style gate shape used by all *-GATE artifacts.
